pages.text: While you hold it, a $(l)glowing golden thread$() trails behind you; follow it back to the entrance. In the boss's second phase it also points toward the boss. Opening the gate does $(l)not use it up$().
$(o)Source$(): Ariadne gave Theseus a ball of thread; he tied it at the entrance and, after killing the Minotaur, followed it out — Apollodorus, $(o)Epitome$() 1.8–9.
